scale_to_pu.note: int16 -> float, x LSB (done on the fly by each consumer)

urms_half.note: direct 100-sample sums per window; per-channel min/max, threshold counters

dft_phasors.note: non-recursive one-cycle DFT at 1 kHz, 100-entry twiddle table

sequence_mag_angle.note: V1, V2; store |V1|, angV1, |V2|/|V1| (3 x 981 floats); V2 kept only for REF and at running argmin

f_dft_J.note: lag-20 angle difference, 20-tap moving average (direct), J from the angle buffer; f_dft buffer kept for the jump-masked second pass

rocof.note: 100-tap least-squares slope kernel (D-016), second pass after the jump mask

dsogi_pll.note: 4 DF2T biquads, pos.-seq., sin/cos/sqrt/div per sample; f_pll features accumulated on the fly after REF

envelope.note: block means, 21-sample running median (insertion sort), 5 Hann windows x 28 bins

thd.note: direct DFT at bins 5h, h = 1..15, 500-entry twiddle table

features_and_rules.note: reductions; median buffers for REF (|V1|, u2, f_dft, Re/Im V2)

c2000_notes: C28x has 16-bit chars: sizeof(float) = 2 words; byte figures here are 8-bit bytes.
Use float only (EABI double is 64-bit; F2837x has no FPU64): build with -Wdouble-promotion.
TMU (F2837xD/F28004x/F28P65x) accelerates sin/cos/atan2/sqrt/div; without it ~5000 x 4 + ~3000 libm calls per record.
Estimated 1.5 M ops x ~2-4 cycles -> ~3-6 M cycles (~15-30 ms at 200 MHz) per record in background context.
Running median (21 samples, 196 times) uses an insertion sort on a 21-float scratch buffer: bounded, no malloc.
Second pass over the phasor-rate buffers (jump mask before ROCOF/df features) needs the 4 KB f_dft buffer.
